# The dock Workspace selects with activePerspective_, carried by the write

Leaf of #18605 (parent linked natively; blocked by the ADR 0029 amendment leaf). `Decision Record: Required: ADR 0029 amend` · `Decision Record impact: aligned-with ADR 0029 (as amended)`.

`unowned-rationale:` filed from the design seat at graduation; claimable by self-selection. Arm owners named in D#18594 stay: F10 @neo-gpt-emmy, F11's evidence @neo-gpt-emmy.

## Context

Matrix A + A1 of D#18594, adopted in the convergence pass after eight non-author cycles: the selection is an **intent config with carried identity**. The receipt at `dev@28e56e1543` (a `PerspectiveWorkspace` subclass, 10/10 in the unit runtime) proved the config shape on the direct branch; Emmy's Group receipts (11/11 and 5/5, same head) proved that existing history rows already carry the names and that replay transport is the missing piece.

## The Problem

A dock Workspace has an active one-of-N and selects it by calling a method. Nothing a provider can bind, nothing a user switch can write back to, no event, and the switcher is rebuilt by hand in every consumer (three today; the ledger is in #18605). `tab.Container` solved the same problem with `activeIndex_` (`src/tab/Container.mjs:56–59`).

## The Architectural Reality

- `Workspace.mjs` (host) holds `dockModel` as a class field (`:411`); `onDockZoneDocumentChange` (`:2299–2315`) has two branches — the Group branch returns `set.commit` / `set.write` without scheduling projection, the direct branch projects then assigns; both reach `projectDockZoneDocument` (`:2342`).
- `Commit.run` (`src/manager/transaction/Commit.mjs:142–175`) pauses Effects across synchronous adoption, appends a row only on `cursorAction: 'append'` (`:149`), and fires `commit` with `{groupId, row, snapshot, transactionId}` (`:175`); `Commit.mjs:126` retains the write's descriptor in the row; rows are `deepFreeze`d (`History.mjs:188`) and `assertRow` (`:218`) admits any plain descriptor. So `{workspaceKey, before, after}` travels for free — what is missing is that undo/redo hand the direction-appropriate name into `project(context)`.
- `Placement.mjs:89` implements `project(context)` for the same Group; Emmy verified it identical with and without the carried fields (STEP_BACK row 6).
- `Authoring.fromZones(panes, zones)` lowers a declared perspective to one document; `Operations.moveItem(doc, {itemId, targetNodeId, index})` is the drift primitive the arms use.
- `beforeSetEnumValue` (`src/core/Base.mjs:454`) is the members-only veto: `console.error` + `oldValue` — the refusal contract below deliberately does **not** return `oldValue`.
- The Neural Link client already restores with descriptor `{name, operation: 'restorePerspective'}` (`src/ai/client/DockService.mjs:522`, `:583`); the same operation name carries the new fields — and under a Group that client call is refused today, because the host routes a descriptor with `operation` into `set.commit`; #18613 moves it onto the write path this leaf establishes.

## The Fix

On `Neo.dashboard.dock.Workspace`:

- `perspectives` — initial-only, captured once at construction (deep clone, like `panes` / `zones`); a later mutation of the declared object is a non-event (F4, measured as arm 9: with capture-once, deleting the selected entry changes nothing and a switch to the "deleted" name still restores). `zones` alone lowers under the reserved declared name (the literal is `$default`: one shared engine constant introduced with this leaf and refused at both persisted write boundaries by #18609).
- `activePerspective_` — the **accepted intent**. `beforeSetActivePerspective` vetoes an unknown name against the captured declared names; the docblock says accepted intent, not completed selection. `afterSetActivePerspective` (skipped on the construction-time first set) restores through the document-write path: on the direct branch `onDockZoneDocumentChange(document, descriptor, source)` projects and assigns; under a Group the descriptor `{operation: 'restorePerspective', workspaceKey, before, after}` must reach `WorkspaceSet.write` as the write's descriptor, never `set.commit` — the host routes any `descriptor.operation` into the reducer, whose vocabulary `restorePerspective` does not join, and the Group refuses an unknown operation (verified by @neo-gpt-emmy at intake: a direct `WorkspaceSet.write` with the same descriptor keeps the row's after-name). No reducer-vocabulary addition. Assigning the current name is a no-op; reset is its own verb (`resetPerspective()`), exactly as in `tab.Container`.
- **Request serial.** Each accepted set takes a serial; a refusal or compensation restores the **last committed name** under the serial, never `oldValue`; a later accepted intent supersedes an earlier pending one (F1).
- **Carried identity.** The accepted write's descriptor carries `{workspaceKey, before, after}` — a documented contract pinned by F10 — and the replay path (`Commit.complete` / the history replay) hands `before` on undo and `after` on redo into `project(context)`; the host's projection reads the carried name and never re-derives it from the document.
- `activePerspectiveChange` fires with `{value, oldValue}` after acceptance, so a `twoWay` binding and a user switch both work (`bind: {activePerspective: {key: 'dock.perspective.active', twoWay: true}}` is the consumer shape; publication itself is the published-truth leaf).
- **Under a Group (OQ11):** a declared perspective lowers to ONE document, but a sibling participant may hold a transferred pane (`Operations.transferItem`). The leaf chooses one of: pull the pane home, retire the vessel, or refuse the restore — and pins the choice in F11; "leave the native window open" is a separate decision from "leave its document unchanged". Evidence for the shape: PR #18595 at `b364a55d87` (retained participant, empty edge root — reset owns the transferred pane in main only, undo in the popup only).
- Destroying the workspace during a pending restore publishes nothing and throws nothing (F5, measured as arm 10).

|---|---|---|---|---|---|

| `Workspace#activePerspective_` (new, reactive) | ADR 0029 §2.1 row "accepted intent" (amendment leaf) | enum veto; accepted name restores via the commit path; event | unknown name → `console.error`, last committed name retained | class docblock | F1, F3, F5 |
| write descriptor `{operation, workspaceKey, before, after}` | `Commit.mjs:126` row retention; `History.assertRow` | carried on every selection write; replay hands the direction-appropriate name to `project(context)` | a write without the fields (selection-free) carries none | `transaction/History` docblock | F2 both halves, F10 |
| `activePerspectiveChange` (new event) | `core/Observable` | fires after acceptance with `{value, oldValue}` | — | docblock | spec |
| restore under a Group | OQ11 disposition | **refuse**: a restore that would duplicate a pane held by a sibling participant is refused before adoption, both documents unchanged (chosen in PR #18625) | — | docblock + guides leaf | F11 |
| `Transaction.write#prepareDescriptor` (new optional request field) | `manager/transaction/Commit.run` | a synchronous, pure `({descriptor, snapshot})` metadata resolver run at the Group queue head; absent means the static descriptor | an async or non-JSON result refuses before adoption | `Transaction#write` docblock | `TransactionWrite.spec.mjs` queue-head arms |
| `project(context).replayRow` (new projection-context field) | `Commit.run` metadata | the frozen prior row on undo/redo, so a participant reads the direction-appropriate name; absent on ordinary writes; the `commit` event payload is unchanged | — | `Commit.run` docblock | F10 undo/redo arm |
| auxiliary identity participant `$perspective:<workspaceKey>` | `Transaction.registerParticipant` (the `Placement` precedent) | domain `dock`, value `{name}`, no `getDocument`; adopted and compensated in the same write as the document; excluded from document membership and persistence | a replacement owner on the same key reuses the retained entry | owner docblock | membership / no-history / compensation arms |
| `Workspace#resetPerspective()` (new method) | this leaf | re-applies the committed declared baseline as an explicit write | no declarations → `{errors: ["no declared perspective"]}` | docblock | reset arm |
| `Authoring.defaultPerspectiveName = '$default'` (new static) | #18609 enforces it at both persisted write boundaries | names the zones-only declaration | — | guides leaf | — |

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] **F1** — A→B→C with B's prepare held, on a real Group (Emmy's harness shape: `Transaction.bind({windowId, workspaceKey})`, `WorkspaceSet`, `set.register(...)`): the published `active` never reads C while B is committed; a refusal of B leaves C's accepted intent intact.
- [ ] **F2** — undo of a switch republishes the previous **name** on the real Group path, two declared names lowering to one document; sequential half (Emmy's receipt) promoted to a committed spec; the concurrent half is F10.
- [ ] **F10** (owner @neo-gpt-emmy) — two accepted selections queued, `operator → review → triage`: the before-name is captured from the actual accepted-write sequence with the same refusal/compensation boundary as the document, and undo returns `review`.
- [ ] **F3** — a pre-construction binding plus a runtime provider re-parent keeps the selection consistent (D#18490's measured re-parent capability).
- [ ] **F5** — `destroy()` during a pending restore publishes nothing and throws nothing.
- [ ] **F11** — a declared-perspective restore on a Group whose sibling participant holds a transferred pane: the committed keyed topology has each pane in exactly one workspace; capture and persistence accept it; the chosen reconciliation is named in the docblock.
- [ ] `beforeSetActivePerspective` refuses an unknown name with a `console.error` naming the declared names; the config's value after refusal is the last committed name, never a stale `oldValue`; assigning the current name is a no-op.
- [ ] `Placement.project` behaves identically with and without the carried fields (a spec pins it).
- [ ] The scratch receipt's arms (`PerspectiveWorkspace`, `CapturedPerspectiveWorkspace`) are promoted into a committed unit spec under `test/playwright/unit/dashboard/`; no scratch file lands.
- [ ] Cross-family review (the PR author is a GPT seat, so the reviewer is a Claude seat); the PR `Refs #18605` and `Resolves` this leaf only.

## Out of Scope

Publication of `dock.perspective.*` (own leaf); the reserved name and snapshot provenance (own leaf); saved-name selection and the bound catalog (deferred in #18605); consumer deletions (own leaves).

## Avoided Traps

Selection as a reducer operation as the identity carrier (matrix C — rejected: the descriptor is already retained); a silent `_activePerspective` write as the sync mechanism; returning `oldValue` on refusal; awaiting the write inside the setter (a setter cannot return the promise — `pending` is the published-truth leaf's answer); a uniform defer of follow-ups (#18598 / PR #18602: the direct branch's immediate `await refreshPromise` is a contract).
